dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You're already here by my side, what more could I ask for?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Though, I would like to know one thing. Is there any way in which I can be of assistance to you, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: You really have a way with words, Kaeya...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: As always, I speak only from the heart.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Nothing would make me feel prouder than knowing that my words of advice are of some help to you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That would imply that you trust me and proves that I am capable of helping you solve your problems.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: In fact... would you like me to compile a guide for you...?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It would contain all kinds of practical knowledge for at home and on the road, including the techniques I have developed for communicating with people from all walks of life. I'd like to share it all with you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'd better get to work then...

choices.text: You never fail to impress me, Kaeya.
Can I rely on your words of wisdom in the future?
